details: [Passive] Buff -> Ballistic now respawns with his Sling weapon in all game modes.
[Tactical] Reworked -> Overheat now only applies to one weapon.
[Tactical] Reworked -> If a player has a weapon out when hit by Whistler the overheat debuff applies only to that weapon.
[Tactical] Reworked -> If the player is unarmed when hit by Whistler it applies to the weapon in the first weapon slot.
[Tactical] Reworked -> Overheat no longer degrades when not firing or swapping to another weapon.
[Tactical] Reworked -> Overheat does not increment when swapping to another weapon and shooting.
[Tactical] Buff -> Overheat damage increased from 15 to 50.
[Tactical] Buff -> Overheat debuff duration increased from 12 to 15.
[Tactical] Buff -> Tactical charges increased from 1 to 2.
[Tactical] Adjust -> The overheat debuff no longer re-applies if you hit someone who is already overheating and you cannot apply it to multiple guns on the same player.
[Ultimate] Buff -> Ballistic and teammates within range get a sprint boost when his Ultimate is activated. (Previously only Ballistic got a speed boost)
[Perks] New -> Extra Bullet: Gain an additional Tactical charge.
[Perks] New -> Trap Mode: When placed in the world, Ballistic’s Tactical lasts 15 seconds and deals 35 damage if an enemy walks into it.
[Perks] New -> Quiet Time: Ballistic’s Tactical no longer applies overheat. Instead it adds silence and slow on hit. It also has a longer cooldown.
[Perks] Adjust -> Killing Time: Now moved to level 3.
[Passive] Buff -> Pathfinder now tucks in his legs while riding horizontal ziplines. This should make him a little harder to hit when riding on his Ultimate and other ziplines in the world.
[Tactical] Buff -> Tactical charges increased from 1 to 2.
[Tactical] Buff -> Removed the progressive cooldown and it is now a flat 20 seconds.
[Ultimate] Buff -> Increased launch speed of the zipline projectile.
[Ultimate] Buff -> Reduced cooldown from 3 minutes to 2 minutes.
[Perks] Buff -> Field Research: Now grants all Recon perks instead of just the survey beacon scan.
[Perks] Buff -> Ringmaster: Now grants all Controller perks instead of just the ring console access.
[Perks] New -> Landing Gear: Grants more air control and faster recovery from hard landings. This replaces the 2 Tactical charges Upgrade.
[Passive] Buff -> Increased the activation speed of the heartbeat sensor.
[Passive] Nerf -> Decreased the interval time between heartbeats.
[Passive] Buff -> Decreased activation time for unarmed ADSing
[Tactical] Buff -> Reduced the delay between the launch and hit.
[Tactical] Buff -> Improved the slow on hit, should now halt faster moving Legends more effectively.
[Ultimate] Buff -> Upon deployment, there is now a quick 2 second scan of the area which will highlight any enemy in the area.
[Ultimate] Buff -> Enemies that enter the area after it’s deployed will also be scanned for 2 seconds.
[Ultimate] Buff -> Cloaked enemies will now show footsteps if they are within the Ultimate zone.
[Tactical] Nerf -> Reduced max in-world count from 3 to 2.
[Tactical] Nerf -> Reduced hp from 150 to 100.

[Tactical] Nerf -> Knocked players can no longer slide across zip codes as Axle or while under the effect of a Nitro Gate. They can still boost through a Nitro Gate, but once the effect times out, they will slow down accordingly.
[Ultimate] Nerf -> Kickstart now displaces victims on a parabolic arc based on their velocity at the moment of impact, instead of straight up.
[Ultimate] Adjust -> Reduced enemy highlight duration slightly to better match stun duration.
[Perks] Nerf -> Super Slider Upgrade no longer grants a second Tactical charge. Instead, it now grants Nitro Gate a 5 second cooldown reduction and +1 max in-world count.
[Tactical] Nerf -> Increased Cooldown from 22 seconds to 28 seconds.
[Ultimate] Nerf -> The speed boost granted from running on the pucks dropped by the wrecking ball has been replaced by a sprint boost. Will no longer speed up all movement, just when sprinting.
[Passive] Nerf -> Removed the recent improvement, which allowed her to land faster from skydiving.
[Tactical] Nerf ->  Decreased Regen Rate from 15/s to 10/s, Increased Regen Duration from 6s to 8s, Decreased Ally Total Regen from 90 to 80, Decreased Conduit Total Regen from 60 to 56
[Tactical] Nerf -> Increased Cooldown from 27 seconds to 30 seconds
[Perks] Adjust -> Instant Barrier: Increased Regen Duration from 4s to 6s
[Perks] Nerf -> Enduring Barrier: No longer grants regen through ring damage
